title: A Prisoner States God's Own Decree — Word for Word
excerpt: The exact clause "worship none but Him" (alla ta'budu illa iyyah, built on the pronoun) appears in exactly two verses: 17:23, where it is what "your Lord has decreed," and 12:40, where an enslaved, imprisoned Yusuf says it to two fellow inmates. The highest voice in existence and one of its lowest-placed people state the law of the universe in the identical words.
seo_title: "Worship None But Him": The Clause Yusuf and God Both Say (12:40, 17:23)
seo_description: The pronoun-exact clause alla ta'budu illa iyyah ("worship none but Him") appears in only two Quran verses: God's decree at 17:23 and Yusuf's words from prison at 12:40. A corpus-verified reading — distinct from the "worship none but Allah" phrasing at 11:2, 41:14, 46:21.
